verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer user-configured background automations, such as scheduled or auto-renewing annual report filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual, interactive filing wizards and an electronic annual-report reminder. That reminder is an adjacent notification feature, not an automation the user sets up to run on its own. Probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or llms.txt that could support autonomous workflows.
